name: Incident postmortem — review template
question: Does this postmortem commit anybody to anything, and would any of its claims survive being asked for the number?
summary: A postmortem modelled as a document graph: four chapters, three claims, two obligations and the evidence that would settle them. It carries the finding postmortems reliably produce — the claim that the failure cannot recur has no evidence behind it, and the obligation to review the change process names nobody. One chapter is left with no analyzer pointed at it, so the gap audit reports that customer impact passes by default. Nothing here describes a real outage, customer, system or window; the incident node is a placeholder for yours.

layers.name: The postmortem as written
layers.role: The document, its chapters, the incident it is about and the process that caused it. No claims belong here.

layers.name: What it claims and commits to
layers.role: Assertions that could be false, obligations they create, and the analyzers responsible for checking them. No evidence belongs here.

layers.name: What would settle it
layers.role: Numbers and systems of record. No opinions and no narrative belong here.

nodes.label: Customer impact
nodes.note: No analyzer is pointed at this chapter, so it passes by default. Deliberate.

nodes.label: Payment path outage
nodes.note: Placeholder. Replace with your own incident, window and blast radius.

nodes.label: A single configuration change caused the outage
The same failure cannot recur
nodes.note: Deliberately unevidenced. This is the claim the template exists to teach.

nodes.label: Add an alert on replication lag
Review the change approval process
nodes.note: No owner and no date. An obligation without both is a sentence, not an obligation.

nodes.label: Unevidenced claim
nodes.note: A claim with nothing behind it that would settle it.

nodes.label: Obligation with no named owner
nodes.note: An action item that will not happen because nobody owns it.

nodes.label: Chapter promised and never written
nodes.note: Content the document commits to and does not contain.

nodes.label: Gateway error logs for the window
Change record for the configuration edit

logic.goal: Decide whether this postmortem can be signed off, and name what is missing if it cannot.

steps.name: Extract chapters, claims and obligations
steps.intent: Lift the structure out of the document before checking anything.

steps.name: Missing content check
steps.intent: Chapters the document promised and never wrote.

steps.name: Proportion gate
steps.intent: Can the corrective actions actually be absorbed by the people named?

steps.name: Sign-off
steps.intent: A named person closes the incident or sends it back.
